pins.definition: To clean something, or a part of the body, using water and usually soap.
To clean something (such as clothes, a car, or part of the body) with water and usually soap.
To clean something—such as dishes, floors, or parts of the body—using water and usually soap.

situation: A man in an old stone backyard scrubs a muddy ceramic bowl under a running garden hose.
subject: the cleaning action with water
brief: A man stands over a round stone sink in a sunlit yard, holding a muddy clay bowl under a clear stream of water pouring from a coiled hose. Frothy white soap suds lift the dark soil away from the centre of the bowl, leaving wet ceramic gleaming brightly under the running stream.
